points.en: Nitroglycerin takes effect in about 3 to 5 minutes (textbook figure) and comes as sublingual spray, fast sublingual tablets, sustained-release tablets, ointment, and patches — a patient who 'puts medicine under the tongue' almost certainly means nitroglycerin.
points.zh: 硝酸甘油教材写起效约 3–5 分钟；剂型有舌下喷雾、速效舌下片、缓释口服片、软膏和贴片——患者说『放在舌头下面的药』，基本就是硝酸甘油。

points.en: Nitroglycerin's heavy venodilation is why the text lists it as a prehospital adjunct for pulmonary edema from left-sided failure: an 'internal phlebotomy' pooling blood in the veins, as if volume had been withdrawn from the body. (BC stance differs — see bcAlerts.)
points.zh: 硝酸甘油显著扩张静脉，因此教材把它列为左心衰肺水肿的院前辅助用药——机制像『体内放血』：血液蓄积在静脉系统里，等效于抽走一部分肺循环血量。（BC 立场不同，见 bcAlerts。）

points.en: When a patient took their own nitro, ask two things: how much, and did it relieve the pain? Four reasons nitro fails: the pain is not cardiac, the pain is extraordinary, it is infarction rather than angina, or the bottle has been open too long and the drug is dead.
points.zh: 患者自服过硝酸甘油，必问两件事：服了多少？疼痛缓解没有？无效的四种解释：疼痛不是心源性、疼痛极其剧烈、是梗死而不是心绞痛、药开封太久已经失效。

points.en: Potent nitro announces itself: throbbing headache, burning under the tongue, bitter taste. No bitter taste or headache suggests an outdated tablet; a pounding headache with zero pain relief points toward AMI.
points.zh: 新鲜有效的硝酸甘油有信号：搏动性头痛、舌下烧灼感、苦味。没有苦味没有头痛，提示药已过期；头痛明显但胸痛毫无缓解，要怀疑 AMI。

points.en: Chronic beta blockade blunts the beta effects of epinephrine during arrest resuscitation — but the alpha vasoconstriction is untouched, so epinephrine remains worth giving.
points.zh: 长期 β 阻滞会钝化骤停复苏中肾上腺素的 β 效应——但 α 缩血管效应不受影响，所以肾上腺素依然值得给。

points.en: Calcium channel blockers stop calcium influx into cardiac muscle: they prevent coronary spasm and weaken contraction to cut oxygen demand, with hypotension as the notable side effect. Diltiazem and verapamil also slow the AV node — their main job today is rate control in atrial fibrillation.
points.zh: 钙通道阻滞剂阻止钙离子进入心肌：既防冠脉痉挛，又减弱收缩力来降低耗氧；显著副作用是低血压。地尔硫卓和维拉帕米还减慢房室结传导——如今主要用于房颤的心室率控制。

points.en: An antidysrhythmic on the med list (amiodarone for VT and life-threatening ventricular dysrhythmias; also sotalol, procainamide, flecainide, mexiletine) certifies a significant dysrhythmia history — keep that patient on the monitor throughout your care.
points.zh: 药单上出现抗心律失常药（胺碘酮=室速及危及生命的室性心律失常；还有索他洛尔、普鲁卡因胺、氟卡尼、美西律等），就等于认证了明确的心律失常史——照护全程都要持续监护。

points.en: Diuretics (furosemide/Lasix, hydrochlorothiazide, metolazone, spironolactone) trick the kidneys into dumping sodium and water — many dump potassium too. Unreplaced hypokalemia invites dysrhythmias, and the danger multiplies if the patient also takes digoxin.
points.zh: 利尿剂（呋塞米 Lasix、氢氯噻嗪、美托拉宗、螺内酯等）让肾脏多排钠排水——很多同时排钾。不补钾的低钾血症容易诱发心律失常，若患者同时在吃地高辛，危险加倍。

points.en: ACE inhibitors (-pril: ramipril, lisinopril, enalapril) and ARBs (-sartan: candesartan, losartan, valsartan) relax arteries, lowering both BP and afterload — workhorses for hypertension and heart failure, often paired with a diuretic.
points.zh: ACEI（后缀 -pril：雷米普利、赖诺普利、依那普利）和 ARB（后缀 -sartan：坎地沙坦、氯沙坦、缬沙坦）通过松弛动脉同时降血压和后负荷——高血压和心衰的主力药，常与利尿剂合用。

points.en: Antihypertensive dosing is hard to titrate, so weakness, dizziness, and orthostatic hypotension are common — check BP in recumbent and sitting positions on every patient taking these drugs.
points.zh: 降压药剂量难拿捏，虚弱、头晕和体位性低血压很常见——所有服降压药的患者都应测卧位+坐位两套血压来筛查体位性低血压。

points.en: Anticoagulants (warfarin; newer oral dabigatran/Pradaxa, rivaroxaban/Xarelto, apixaban/Eliquis; subcutaneous heparins) mark patients with AF, artificial valves, or prior PE/MI — expect heavy bleeding from minor trauma or venipuncture. Antiplatelets center on ASA, with clopidogrel, ticagrelor, or prasugrel added for acute STEMI.
points.zh: 抗凝药（华法林；新型口服药达比加群 Pradaxa、利伐沙班 Xarelto、阿哌沙班 Eliquis；皮下肝素类）提示房颤、机械瓣或 PE/MI 病史——轻微创伤或穿刺都可能出血不止。抗血小板药以 ASA 为核心，急性 STEMI 常加氯吡格雷、替格瑞洛或普拉格雷。

atScene.en: Adequate perfusion needs all three: a pump (heart), a container (vessels), and fluid (blood) — lose any one and perfusion fails.
atScene.zh: 足够的灌注需要三件套同时在线：泵（心脏）、容器（血管）、液体（血液）——缺一个，灌注就垮。

atScene.en: Atropine is an anticholinergic with vagolytic properties: it blocks ACh at the SA and AV nodes and lifts the vagal brake on a slow heart.
atScene.zh: 阿托品是带解迷走作用的抗胆碱能药：在窦房结和房室结挡住乙酰胆碱，把压着慢心率的迷走「刹车」松开。

atScene.en: Abbreviation discipline: PE means pulmonary embolism — never write PE for pulmonary edema.
atScene.zh: 缩写纪律：PE 只代表肺栓塞——绝不要拿 PE 去写肺水肿。

atScene.en: Chest pain is ACS until the hospital rules it out: a 12-lead can rule IN a STEMI but cannot exclude ACS — only serial biomarkers can.
atScene.zh: 胸痛在医院排除之前都算 ACS：12 导联能「确诊」STEMI，却排除不了 ACS——能排除的只有连续的生物标志物。

atScene.en: Nancy's rule: start treatment immediately for any patient with chest pain — assessment and management run in parallel, not in sequence.
atScene.zh: Nancy 铁律：任何胸痛病人都立即开始治疗——评估和处置并行推进，不是先评估完再治。

atScene.en: The handshake exam: while introducing yourself, a quick radial palpation already gives you rate, rhythm, and a rough BP — and picks out the very sick.
atScene.zh: 握手查体：自我介绍握手的同时顺手摸桡动脉，心率、节律、血压粗值全到手——重病人一摸便知。

atScene.en: Treat the patient, not the monitor: the ECG shows electrical activity only — it says nothing about mechanical pumping, and an unobtainable SpO2 reading is itself a low-output clue.
atScene.zh: 治病人，别治监护仪：ECG 只反映电活动——机械泵血它一个字不提；血氧仪读不出数，本身就是低心输出量的线索。

atScene.en: Start the IV in the left arm when possible: cath labs favour the right radial artery for cardiac procedures.
atScene.zh: 静脉通路尽量避开右臂：导管室做心脏介入偏爱右侧桡动脉。

atScene.en: Cable placement memory: 'white is on the right, smoke over fire' (black above red on the left) — or salt, pepper, ketchup going around from the right.
atScene.zh: 导线位置口诀：「白在右，烟在火上」（左侧黑在红上）——或者从右边数过去：盐（白）、胡椒（黑）、番茄酱（红）。

atScene.en: If the whole PQRST is upright in aVR, the arm leads are switched — fix the cables before you 'diagnose' anything.
atScene.zh: aVR 里整组 PQRST 都直立＝左右手导联接反了——先把线换回来，再谈任何「诊断」。

atScene.en: Flat line on an alert, talking patient = a loose lead. Wavy VF-lookalike baseline on a comfortable patient = artifact. Look at the patient before you reach for the paddles.
atScene.zh: 清醒说话的病人出现直线＝导联脱落。安然无恙的病人出现貌似 VF 的波浪基线＝伪差。伸手拿电极板之前，先看病人。

atScene.en: Pathologic Q waves on a routine ECG mean an evolved MI of unknown age — the physician's first question will be 'when was the MI?'
atScene.zh: 常规 ECG 上看到病理性 Q 波＝年代不明的陈旧心梗——医生的第一个问题一定是「什么时候梗过？」

atScene.en: Every inferior STEMI gets a 15-lead (or at least V4R) BEFORE nitroglycerin — a preload-dependent right ventricle can crash the pressure on one spray.
atScene.zh: 每一个下壁 STEMI 都要先做 15 导（至少 V4R）再考虑硝酸甘油——依赖前负荷的右心室可能一喷就把血压打垮。

atScene.en: Nancy's rule: heavy, crushing, squeezing, or choking chest pain is treated as AMI even when the ECG looks perfectly normal.
atScene.zh: Nancy 铁律：沉重、压榨、紧勒、窒息样的胸痛，就算 ECG 看起来完全正常，也按 AMI 处理。

atScene.en: Unresponsive, pulseless LVAD patient: before any compressions, auscultate for the hum, get a Doppler MAP, and look for perfusion signs — then dial the patient's 24/7 device line for troubleshooting and destination advice.
atScene.zh: LVAD 患者无反应又摸不到脉：按压之前先听心前区嗡鸣、用 Doppler 测 MAP、找灌注征象——然后拨打患者随身的 24/7 装置热线，边排障边定转运目的地。

atScene.en: Moving an IABP or Impella patient, the kill risk is line tension: assign one person to watch tubing and cables through every lift, load, and unload, and keep the device specialist beside the pump.
atScene.zh: 搬运 IABP 或 Impella 患者，致命风险是管线受牵拉：每一次抬、装车、卸车都要专人盯住导管和线缆，装置专责人员必须守在泵旁。

atScene.en: Before your own nitro, interrogate theirs: how many doses, any relief, any bitter taste or headache? A pounding headache with unrelieved pain reframes this call as probable AMI, not angina.
atScene.zh: 给你自己的硝酸甘油之前，先审患者自服的那份：吃了几剂？缓解没有？有没有苦味和头痛？头痛明显但疼痛不减，这单就要按疑似 AMI 而不是心绞痛来打。

atScene.en: In BC chest pain calls, ASA comes early — it is the one drug that needs no vitals first — and transport rolls after the first nitro dose, not after the pain settles.
atScene.zh: BC 的胸痛出勤里，ASA 要趁早——它是唯一给药前不用先测生命体征的药；而且首剂硝酸甘油一给就启动转运，不是等疼痛压下去再走。

atScene.en: A beta blocker on the med list does not cancel epinephrine in arrest: beta response may be blunted, but alpha vasoconstriction still works for you.
atScene.zh: 药单上有 β 阻滞剂，不等于骤停时肾上腺素作废：β 反应可能被钝化，但 α 缩血管效应照样为你干活。

atScene.en: Every patient on antihypertensives gets two blood pressures — recumbent and sitting — before you stand them up; orthostatic hypotension is the fall you can prevent.
atScene.zh: 服降压药的患者一律测两套血压——卧位一套、坐位一套——再让人起身；体位性低血压是你能提前拦住的那次跌倒。

confusions.en: Cardiovascular emergencies are not mainly monitor interpretation — perfusion assessment (skin, mentation, pulse quality, BP trend) stays central; the body shows poor perfusion before the rhythm gets a name.
confusions.zh: 心血管急症不等于看监护仪——灌注评估（皮肤、意识、脉搏质量、血压趋势）才是核心；身体总在心律「叫得出名字」之前就先暴露灌注不良。

confusions.en: Chest pain is not a pain-control problem but an ischemia problem: ASA is the mortality-cutting drug, analgesia is secondary and opioids can even blunt lifesaving antiplatelets.
confusions.zh: 胸痛不是止痛问题，是缺血问题：真正降死亡率的是阿司匹林；镇痛是次要目标，阿片类甚至会拖累救命的抗血小板药。

confusions.en: Respiratory and cardiac complaints overlap: a 'cardiac wheeze' from pulmonary edema mimics asthma, salbutamol rarely helps it, and the tachycardia worsens the failing heart.
confusions.zh: 呼吸主诉和心脏主诉常常是一回事：肺水肿的「心源性哮鸣」会伪装成哮喘，沙丁胺醇对它基本无效，带来的心动过速反而加重心衰。

confusions.en: Ventricular filling percentages look contradictory in the book (about 80% passive in the cardiac-cycle section; 70% by gravity plus 30% atrial kick in the conduction section) — safe exam answer: the majority (70-80%) fills passively, atrial kick tops up the final 20-30%.
confusions.zh: 教材里心室充盈比例前后不一（心动周期一节说约 80% 被动充盈；传导一节说 70% 靠重力＋30% 靠心房收缩）——保险的考试答案：大头（70-80%）是被动充盈，心房收缩补最后的 20-30%。

confusions.en: Unstable angina vs NSTEMI: same story, same exam, same ECG — only biomarkers separate them (elevated = NSTEMI). STEMI is the odd one out: the 12-lead alone declares it.
confusions.zh: 不稳定型心绞痛 vs NSTEMI：病史一样、查体一样、ECG 一样——只有生物标志物能分开它们（升高＝NSTEMI）。STEMI 才是例外：单凭 12 导联即可宣判。

confusions.en: Nitroglycerin relieves anginal pain but does not open a thrombosed artery and does not lower AMI mortality — do not equate symptom relief with lifesaving therapy; in acute heart failure, though, nitro IS the mortality-reducing mainstay.
confusions.zh: 硝酸甘油能缓解心绞痛，但打不开血栓堵死的动脉、也不降低心梗死亡率——别把「症状缓解」当成「救命治疗」；可一换到急性心衰场景，硝酸甘油恰恰是降死亡率的主力。这两个场景最容易考混。

confusions.en: Three look-alike pulse terms: pulse deficit (radial below apical, or left radial absent), pulsus paradoxus (inspiratory SBP drop over 10 mm Hg — tamponade), pulsus alternans (strong-weak alternation) — exams love swapping their definitions.
confusions.zh: 三个长得像的脉搏术语：脉搏短绌（桡动脉数低于心尖、或左桡缺失）、奇脉（吸气 SBP 掉超 10 mmHg——填塞）、交替脉（一强一弱交替）——考题最爱把定义互换来挖坑。

confusions.en: Tamponade vs tension pneumothorax in the hypotensive trauma patient: tamponade keeps equal breath sounds and a midline trachea; tension pneumo silences one side and pushes the trachea away.
confusions.zh: 低血压创伤病人里的填塞 vs 张力性气胸：填塞呼吸音两侧对称、气管居中；张力性气胸一侧呼吸音消失、气管被推向对侧。

confusions.en: Dissection vs AMI: dissection pain is maximal from the first minute, tearing, radiates to the interscapular back, no prodrome, never abates; AMI builds gradually with nausea/sweating prodrome. Managements diverge hard: dissection gets NO ASA and NO nitro.
confusions.zh: 夹层 vs 心梗：夹层疼痛第一分钟就到顶、撕裂样、放射到肩胛间背部、无前驱、不会自行减轻；心梗是带恶心出汗前奏的渐进式。处置分道扬镳：夹层禁 ASA、禁硝酸甘油。

confusions.en: Right-side failure alone is seldom an emergency and is most often caused by left-side failure; the sorting clue is pulmonary edema — present means secondary to left failure, absent points to primary lung or right-heart disease.
confusions.zh: 单纯右心衰很少是急症，而且它最常见的病因就是左心衰；分拣线索是肺水肿——有肺水肿＝继发于左心衰，没有＝原发于肺或右心的问题。

confusions.en: A hypertensive EMERGENCY is defined by end-organ damage, not the cuff number — and one high reading on a stressful scene never diagnoses chronic hypertension.
confusions.zh: 高血压「急症」由终末器官损害定义，不由袖带数字定义——现场应激下的一次高读数，也永远不能给人扣上慢性高血压的帽子。

confusions.en: Furosemide and morphine are legacy pulmonary-edema drugs now under caution: furosemide only in small doses (delayed diuresis, reflex afterload rise), morphine rarely (sedation breeds intubation) — nitroglycerin plus CPAP are today's workhorses.
confusions.zh: 呋塞米和吗啡是肺水肿的「上个时代」用药，如今都要小心：呋塞米只敢小剂量（利尿迟、反射性抬后负荷），吗啡基本不用（镇静催生插管）——现在的主力是硝酸甘油＋CPAP。

confusions.en: Norepinephrine is chiefly ALPHA (vasoconstrictor of choice, fewer dysrhythmias than dopamine); epinephrine is chiefly BETA (arrest and anaphylaxis) — students reliably reverse these two.
confusions.zh: 去甲肾上腺素以 alpha 为主（首选缩血管药，比多巴胺少心律失常）；肾上腺素以 beta 为主（骤停和过敏首选）——这俩被记反的概率极高。

confusions.en: Mobitz I vs Mobitz II: type I stretches the PRI longer and longer until a beat drops (always irregular, usually benign); type II keeps the PRI absolutely constant and simply drops beats (more dangerous, pacing territory).
confusions.zh: Mobitz I vs II：I 型 PRI 越拉越长直到掉一跳（必然不规则，通常良性）；II 型 PRI 纹丝不动、直接掉跳（更凶险，属于要准备起搏的那一类）。

confusions.en: Third-degree block is NOT 'chaos': both the P-P and R-R are regular — they just ignore each other. A regular rhythm with an inconsistent PRI is almost certainly third-degree.
confusions.zh: 三度阻滞不是「乱」：P-P 规则、R-R 也规则——只是彼此互不理睬。节律规整而 PRI 不恒定，几乎必是三度。

confusions.en: Agonal rhythm vs idioventricular rhythm: both are slow and ugly, but agonal (under 20/min) never produces a pulse; an idioventricular rhythm might.
confusions.zh: 濒死心律 vs 室性自主心律：都又慢又难看，但濒死心律（低于 20 次/分）永远摸不到脉；室性自主心律可能有脉。

confusions.en: AF vs atrial flutter: AF is irregularly irregular with no P waves at all; flutter shows sawtooth F waves and usually runs regular 2:1 with a ventricular rate right around 150.
confusions.zh: 房颤 vs 房扑：房颤是「不规则地不规则」且完全没有 P 波；房扑是锯齿状 F 波、通常规则 2:1 下传、室率正卡在 150 左右。

confusions.en: Defibrillate (unsynchronized) only pulseless VF/VT; synchronized cardioversion only unstable tachycardia WITH a pulse; asystole gets neither — shocking it is useless and possibly harmful.
confusions.zh: 非同步除颤只给无脉的 VF/VT；同步电复律只给有脉的不稳定过速；asystole 两个都不给——电它无用甚至有害。

confusions.en: A normal ECG does not rule out AMI, and a 'nondiagnostic' ECG does not mean 'no MI' — changes may take hours to appear. Treat the story.
confusions.zh: ECG 正常不能排除心梗，「非诊断性」也不等于「没有心梗」——图上的改变可能要几小时才浮现。要治的是病史。

confusions.en: Sinus tachycardia is a symptom, not a disease: it compensates for pain, fever, hypovolemia, or hypoxia. Chemically slowing a compensatory rhythm can kill the patient.
confusions.zh: 窦速是症状不是病：它在替疼痛、发热、低血容量、缺氧代偿。用药把代偿性心率压下去，可能直接害死病人。

confusions.en: Preexcited (WPW) AF looks like 'just fast AF' but is irregular, WIDE, and over 200/min — adenosine, beta blockers, and calcium channel blockers are all contraindicated; the answer is synchronized cardioversion.
confusions.zh: 预激（WPW）房颤看着像「快一点的房颤」，其实是不规则＋宽 QRS＋室率超 200——腺苷、β 阻滞剂、钙通道阻滞剂全部禁用；答案是同步电复律。

confusions.en: Hyperkalemia vs hypokalemia on ECG: high K = tall, peaked, tented T waves heading toward a sine wave; low K = flat T waves plus a U wave after the T.
confusions.zh: 高钾 vs 低钾的 ECG：高钾＝高、尖、帐篷样 T 波，严重时走向正弦波；低钾＝T 波低平、T 后多出一个 U 波。

confusions.en: VT vs SVT with aberrancy: both are fast and wide, but dissociated P waves peeking out at varying spots inside the QRS argue VT. When in doubt in an unstable patient, treat as VT.
confusions.zh: VT vs 室上速伴差传：都又快又宽，但 QRS 里位置游移、若隐若现的分离 P 波指向 VT。拿不准而病人不稳定时，一律按 VT 处理。

confusions.en: Pulseless LVAD patient = cardiac arrest? No. A normally running LVAD produces continuous flow with no pulse; declare arrest only after no hum, no MAP, and no signs of circulation. Blind compressions risk cannula displacement.
confusions.zh: 误区：LVAD 患者摸不到脉=骤停。错。正常运转的 LVAD 本来就是连续血流、无脉搏；只有无嗡鸣+无 MAP+无循环征象三样齐了才按骤停处理。上来就盲目按压，反而可能压脱套管。

confusions.en: Nitroglycerin saves lives in ACS? No — it treats ischemic pain but does not cut mortality. ASA is the mortality-reducing drug and the single most important medication to give.
confusions.zh: 误区：ACS 里硝酸甘油是救命药。错——它只处理缺血性疼痛，不降低死亡率。真正降低死亡率、最重要的那颗药是 ASA。

confusions.en: On LVAD patients, trust the monitor? SpO2 is often unreliable and a cuff may read nothing — clinical perfusion signs (mentation, skin, cap refill) plus a Doppler MAP outrank the numbers.
confusions.zh: 误区：LVAD 患者看监护仪读数就行。它的 SpO2 常不可靠、普通血压计可能什么都量不出——意识、皮肤、毛细血管再充盈这些临床灌注征象加 Doppler MAP，比屏幕数字更算数。

confusions.en: One med proves one disease? A beta blocker could mean angina, hypertension, heart failure, or a prior MI — medications narrow the field only when read against history and the whole list.
confusions.zh: 误区：看到一种药就能锁定一种病。一颗 β 阻滞剂背后可能是心绞痛、高血压、心衰或 MI 病史——药物必须对着病史和整张药单读才有意义。

confusions.en: Digoxin toxicity has a signature rhythm? Virtually any dysrhythmia can be digoxin — which is exactly why every rhythm-disturbance patient gets asked about it.
confusions.zh: 误区：地高辛中毒有特定的『标志心律』。实际上几乎任何心律失常都可能是地高辛干的——这正是每个心律紊乱患者都要被问『吃不吃地高辛』的原因。

confusions.en: Nitro didn't work, so the pain isn't cardiac? Four explanations exist, and one is simply a stale, opened bottle — no bitter taste and no headache betray dead tablets, not a benign chest.
confusions.zh: 误区：硝酸甘油无效=疼痛不是心脏的。无效有四种解释，其中一种只是药开封太久失效了——没有苦味、没有头痛，暴露的是死药片，不是安全的胸痛。

confusions.en: IABP and Impella do the same job? The IABP pumps no blood — it counterpulsates with the ECG to cut afterload and boost coronary perfusion; the Impella actively pumps up to 5 L/min of continuous flow and needs no synchronization.
confusions.zh: 误区：IABP 和 Impella 干的是同一件事。IABP 自己不泵血——它靠 ECG 同步反搏来降后负荷、提冠脉灌注；Impella 则是真的在泵血，连续流最高 5 L/min，完全不需要同步。

mnemonics.name: Mighty Mitral
mnemonics.en: The MITRAL valve guards the MIGHTY side: left heart, high pressure — tricuspid takes the weaker right.
mnemonics.zh: 二尖瓣守的是「大力士」那一侧：左心、高压——三尖瓣管压力低的右心。记住 mitral＝mighty＝左。

mnemonics.name: One heart, two lungs
mnemonics.en: How many hearts? One — beta-1. How many lungs? Two — beta-2.
mnemonics.zh: 几颗心？一颗——beta-1 管心。几个肺？两个——beta-2 管肺。

mnemonics.name: OPQRST
mnemonics.en: Onset, Provocation/Palliation, Quality, Radiation, Severity, Timing — the chest-pain history frame.
mnemonics.zh: 起病、诱因/缓解、性质、放射、程度、时间——胸痛问诊的六格框架。

mnemonics.name: Beck Triad
mnemonics.en: Tamponade's three: hypotension, jugular distention, muffled heart sounds — 'the pressure falls, the neck swells, the heart goes quiet'.
mnemonics.zh: 填塞三件套：血压低、颈静脉胀、心音闷——「压掉了、脖子鼓了、心声远了」。

mnemonics.name: Time is muscle
mnemonics.en: Every minute a coronary stays occluded kills more myocardium — reperfusion speed is the treatment.
mnemonics.zh: 冠脉多堵一分钟，心肌多死一片——再灌注的速度本身就是治疗。

mnemonics.name: CAB flip
mnemonics.en: Conscious cardiac patient: assess ABC. Unresponsive with suspected arrest: flip to CAB — circulation first.
mnemonics.zh: 清醒的心脏病人查 ABC；无反应、疑似骤停立刻翻成 CAB——循环先行。

mnemonics.name: White right, smoke over fire
mnemonics.en: Limb cables: WHITE on the right shoulder; on the left, SMOKE (black) sits above FIRE (red). Alternative: salt, pepper, ketchup.
mnemonics.zh: 肢体导线：白色在右肩；左侧「烟压着火」——黑在上、红在下。备用版：盐、胡椒、番茄酱。

mnemonics.en: Sequence method: from an R wave on a heavy line, each following large square reads 300, 150, 100, 75, 60, 50 — regular rhythms only.
mnemonics.zh: 序列法：从落在粗线上的 R 波起，后面每一条大格线依次念 300、150、100、75、60、50——只适用于规则节律。

mnemonics.name: ×10 in 6 seconds
mnemonics.en: Count QRS complexes in a 6-second strip and multiply by 10 — the fast method, and the only fair one for irregular rhythms.
mnemonics.zh: 数 6 秒图条里的 QRS 个数乘 10——最快的方法，也是不规则节律唯一公平的方法。

mnemonics.name: Hs & Ts (5H5T)
mnemonics.en: Reversible arrest causes: Hypoxia, Hypovolemia, Hydrogen ions, Hyper/Hypokalemia, Hypothermia; Tamponade, Tension pneumothorax, Thrombosis (lung), Thrombosis (heart), Toxins.
mnemonics.zh: 可逆骤停病因：缺氧、低血容量、氢离子（酸中毒）、高/低钾、低体温；心包填塞、张力性气胸、肺血栓、冠脉血栓、毒物。

mnemonics.name: Wall map
mnemonics.en: II-III-aVF inferior; V1-V2 septal; V3-V4 anterior; V5-V6 + I + aVL lateral; V4R right ventricle; V8-V9 posterior.
mnemonics.zh: 定位地图：II-III-aVF 下壁；V1-V2 间隔；V3-V4 前壁；V5-V6＋I＋aVL 侧壁；V4R 右室；V8-V9 后壁。

mnemonics.name: Three Ns (textbook TOR)
mnemonics.en: BLS termination poem: No shocks delivered, No ROSC, Not seen (witnessed) by the team. BC's exam replaces this with the 30/40-minute clock.
mnemonics.zh: 教材版终止口诀三个 N：没电过（No shocks）、没恢复（No ROSC）、没目击（Not seen）。BC 考纲用 30/40 分钟计时规则取而代之。

mnemonics.name: HUM（LVAD 三查）
mnemonics.en: Hear the hum — Use a Doppler for MAP — Make the call (24/7 device line). Three checks before you ever treat a pulseless LVAD patient as an arrest.
mnemonics.zh: H 听嗡鸣（Hear the hum）→ U 用 Doppler 测 MAP（Use Doppler）→ M 拨热线（Make the call，24/7 装置热线）。把无脉的 LVAD 患者当骤停之前，三步先走完。

mnemonics.name: 110–50/150–24/48（BC 硝酸甘油四道闸）
mnemonics.en: SBP must stay above 110; HR must sit between 50 and 150; Viagra/Levitra locks nitro out for 24 h, Cialis for 48 h.
mnemonics.zh: SBP 必须 >110；HR 必须在 50–150 之间；Viagra/Levitra 封锁 24 小时，Cialis 封锁 48 小时。四道闸全过才给药。

mnemonics.name: NBC（抗心绞痛三类）
mnemonics.en: Nitrates, Beta blockers, Calcium channel blockers — the whole 'network' broadcasts on the demand side: all three cut myocardial oxygen consumption.
mnemonics.zh: N 硝酸酯、B β 阻滞剂、C 钙通道阻滞剂——这个『电视台』只播需求侧节目：三类全是降心肌耗氧。

mnemonics.name: 药名后缀速判
mnemonics.en: -olol = beta blocker; -pril = ACE inhibitor; -sartan = ARB; -dipine = dihydropyridine CCB. Suffixes sort most cardiac med lists in seconds.
mnemonics.zh: -olol=β 阻滞剂；-pril=ACEI；-sartan=ARB；-dipine=二氢吡啶类钙拮抗剂。靠后缀几秒钟就能把大半张心脏药单归类。

mnemonics.name: 地高辛怕『低钾高钙』
mnemonics.en: Digoxin fears low K and given Ca: hypokalemia (from diuretics or bicarbonate loads) and calcium preparations both magnify its toxicity.
mnemonics.zh: 地高辛怕两样：钾低了（利尿剂、大量碳酸氢钠都会排钾）和钙来了（对钙剂高度敏感）——两样都会放大毒性。

selfCheck.qEn: List the BC nitroglycerin contraindications and the dosing pattern.
selfCheck.qZh: 背出 BC 版硝酸甘油禁忌和给药节奏。
selfCheck.aEn: SBP <110, HR <50 or >150, nitrate allergy, Viagra/Levitra within 24 h, Cialis within 48 h; 0.4 mg SL q3-5 min, max 3 doses per 30 minutes, SBP must stay >110, pre-arrival nitro counts.
selfCheck.aZh: SBP <110、心率 <50 或 >150、硝酸酯过敏、24 小时内 Viagra/Levitra、48 小时内 Cialis；0.4 mg 舌下、每 3-5 分钟一次、任意 30 分钟 ≤3 剂、全程 SBP 必须 >110，病人自服的也计入。

selfCheck.qEn: Intrinsic rates of the three pacemaker tiers?
selfCheck.qZh: 三级起搏点的固有频率各是多少？
selfCheck.aEn: SA node 60-100, AV junction 40-60, Purkinje system 20-40 beats/min.
selfCheck.aZh: 窦房结 60-100、房室交界 40-60、浦肯野系统 20-40 次/分。

selfCheck.qEn: What separates unstable angina from NSTEMI, and NSTEMI from STEMI?
selfCheck.qZh: 不稳定型心绞痛和 NSTEMI 怎么分？NSTEMI 和 STEMI 又怎么分？
selfCheck.aEn: UA vs NSTEMI: biomarkers only (ECG identical; elevated = NSTEMI). STEMI: declared on the 12-lead alone, no biomarkers needed.
selfCheck.aZh: UA vs NSTEMI：只能靠生物标志物（ECG 一样；升高＝NSTEMI）。STEMI：单凭 12 导联即可判定，不需要标志物。

selfCheck.qEn: Name the Beck triad and its condition; what is the best field clue?
selfCheck.qZh: Beck 三联征是什么、对应什么病？现场最有用的线索是？
selfCheck.aEn: Hypotension + jugular venous distention + muffled heart sounds = cardiac tamponade; best field clue is pulsus paradoxus (inspiratory SBP drop >10 mm Hg).
selfCheck.aZh: 低血压＋颈静脉怒张＋心音遥远＝心包填塞；现场最有用的线索是奇脉（吸气 SBP 掉超 10 mmHg）。

selfCheck.qEn: Which ACS drug actually cuts mortality, and what is the BC dose?
selfCheck.qZh: ACS 里真正降死亡率的药是哪个？BC 剂量多少？
selfCheck.aEn: Aspirin — BC dose 160 mg chewed (book range 160-325 mg), the only med needing no prior vitals. Nitro relieves pain but does not lower AMI mortality.
selfCheck.aZh: 阿司匹林——BC 剂量 160 mg 嚼服（教材范围 160-325 mg），也是唯一不需要先测生命体征的药。硝酸甘油只缓解疼痛，不降低心梗死亡率。

selfCheck.qEn: Signature signs of left-side versus right-side heart failure?
selfCheck.qZh: 左心衰 vs 右心衰的招牌体征？
selfCheck.aEn: Left = pulmonary: orthopnea, PND, crackles, cardiac wheeze, pink frothy sputum. Right = systemic: JVD, pedal/presacral edema, tender hepatomegaly — most often caused by left failure itself.
selfCheck.aZh: 左＝肺循环：端坐呼吸、夜间阵发性呼吸困难、湿啰音、心源性哮鸣、粉红泡沫痰。右＝体循环：颈静脉怒张、足部/骶前水肿、压痛性肝大——而右衰最常见的原因正是左衰。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Withhold for hypotension, HR below 50 or above 160, known right ventricular infarction, or PDE5 inhibitors within 24-72 h (sildenafil/vardenafil 24 h, tadalafil up to 72 h); no IV line is a relative contraindication; stop if SBP falls by more than one-third.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：低血压、心率 <50 或 >160、已知右室梗死、24-72 小时内用过 PDE5 抑制剂（西地那非/伐地那非 24 小时、他达拉非最长 72 小时）都不给；无静脉通路属相对禁忌；SBP 掉超初始值三分之一就停。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC exam set: SBP below 110 (must stay above 110 to keep dosing), HR below 50 or above 150, nitrate allergy/sensitivity, Viagra or Levitra within 24 h, Cialis within 48 h. No RVI or IV-line clause at this level — answer with the BC list.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲版：SBP <110（给药全程必须 >110）、心率 <50 或 >150、硝酸酯过敏/敏感、24 小时内用过 Viagra/Levitra、48 小时内用过 Cialis。此级别不考右室梗死和静脉通路条款——答题用 BC 清单。

bcAlerts.bookEn: 0.3-0.4 mg SL, repeat every 5 minutes for 3-6 doses while the patient stays stable.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：0.3-0.4 mg 舌下，病情稳定时每 5 分钟重复、共 3-6 剂。
bcAlerts.bcEn: 0.4 mg SL every 3-5 minutes, maximum 3 doses in any 30-minute period, counted irrespective of nitro the patient took before your arrival; do not shake the spray; a nitro patch on the skin changes nothing. Pain fully relieved for over 5 minutes then returning = a NEW episode — restart the nitro component (not the ASA).
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC：0.4 mg 舌下、每 3-5 分钟一次、任意 30 分钟内最多 3 剂——病人在你到场前自服的硝酸甘油也一并计入；喷剂用前不摇瓶；身上贴着硝酸甘油贴片不改变协议。疼痛完全缓解超过 5 分钟后复发＝新发作——硝酸甘油部分可重启（ASA 不重复）。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Chew 160-325 mg non-enteric-coated unless allergy, GI bleeding, or recent head injury/hemorrhagic stroke.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：嚼服 160-325 mg 非肠溶片，除非过敏、消化道出血、近期头外伤或出血性中风。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC dose is exactly 160 mg PO chewed, and ASA is the ONLY medication given without vitals first. Contraindications: cannot swallow, allergy, active peptic ulcer or GI bleed, already took the recommended dose before your arrival, salicylate/NSAID-induced asthma, pediatric viral symptoms. Cautions: recent internal bleeding or surgery, bleeding disorders, anticoagulants, possible pregnancy.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 剂量就是 160 mg 口服嚼碎，而且 ASA 是唯一「给药前不需要生命体征」的药。禁忌：不能吞咽、过敏、活动性消化性溃疡/消化道出血、到场前已服过推荐剂量、水杨酸/NSAID 诱发哮喘史、有病毒症状的儿科病人。慎用：近期内出血或手术、出血性疾病、抗凝药、可能怀孕。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Oxygen target in cardiac chest pain
bcAlerts.topicZh: 心源性胸痛的氧饱和目标
bcAlerts.bookEn: No routine oxygen: give only if SpO2 is below 90%, titrate to 90-94%, avoid hyperoxia.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：不常规给氧——SpO2 <90% 才给，滴定到 90-94%，避免氧过量。
bcAlerts.bcEn: The BC chest-pain protocol orders oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 of 94% or higher. For protocol questions answer 94%+; keep the book's hyperoxia rationale for physiology questions.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 胸痛协议要求按需给氧、把 SpO2 维持在 ≥94%。协议题答 ≥94%；教材那套「氧过量有害」的道理留给机理题。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook ACS pathway has no nitrous oxide step at all — analgesia escalates from nitro to (reluctant) opioids.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材的 ACS 流程里根本没有笑气这一步——镇痛从硝酸甘油直接（勉强）升级到阿片。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC uniquely adds Entonox: when pain persists beyond 3 nitro doses OR SBP drops below 110, give Entonox starting 5 minutes after the last nitro (nitro within 5 minutes is an Entonox contraindication). At 30 minutes from the first nitro dose the whole protocol may repeat after stopping N2O for 5 minutes; if hospital arrival is not imminent 20 minutes after the last nitro, stop Entonox, resume high-flow O2 and further nitro.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 独有 Entonox 环节：疼痛熬过 3 剂硝酸甘油仍在、或 SBP 掉到 110 以下时，在最后一剂硝酸甘油 5 分钟后开始给 Entonox（5 分钟内用过硝酸甘油是 Entonox 的禁忌）。距首剂硝酸甘油满 30 分钟后，停笑气 5 分钟即可整套协议重来；若最后一剂硝酸甘油后 20 分钟还到不了医院，停 Entonox、恢复高流量氧并继续按协议给硝酸甘油。

bcAlerts.topicZh: BC 协议里的 12 导联
bcAlerts.bookEn: The book makes early 12-lead acquisition (before therapy) and STEMI bypass to PCI centres the backbone of ACS care.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把「治疗前尽早做 12 导联」和「STEMI 绕行直送 PCI 中心」当成 ACS 处置的骨架。
bcAlerts.bcEn: The BC exam's chest-pain protocol contains no 12-lead step at the EMR/PCP level: the tested sequence is position/limit movement, O2, ASA, initiate transport, history and vitals, then nitro. Answer protocol questions with that order; keep 12-lead knowledge for physiology/rationale items.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲的胸痛协议在 EMR/PCP 级别没有 12 导联这一步：考的顺序是「体位/限制活动 → 给氧 → ASA → 启动转运 → 病史＋生命体征 → 硝酸甘油」。协议题按这个顺序答；12 导联的知识留给机理题。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Hypotension and fluids at PCP level
bcAlerts.topicZh: PCP 级别的低血压补液
bcAlerts.bookEn: For cardiogenic shock the book uses a physician-ordered rapid 250 mL saline trial plus titrated vasopressors (dopamine, norepinephrine).
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材对心源性休克用「医嘱下快速试推 250 mL 生理盐水」＋滴定升压药（多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素）。
bcAlerts.bcEn: The BC PCP pattern for volume-related hypotension is a 20 mL/kg fluid bolus to a maximum of 2 L, reassessing every 500 mL, targeting SBP 90 — and vasopressors are not in PCP scope. Exam answers use the 20 mL/kg / 2 L / 500 mL / SBP 90 frame.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC PCP 对容量相关低血压的模式是：20 mL/kg 推注、上限 2 L、每 500 mL 重新评估、目标 SBP 90——升压药不在 PCP 执业范围内。考试就按 20 mL/kg / 2 L / 500 mL / SBP 90 这套答。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.48 等（PCP 补液通用模式）

bcAlerts.bookEn: Canadian BLS-TOR/ALS-TOR rules: discuss with a physician after 15-20 minutes of ACLS and three medication rounds; 'no shock, no ROSC, not witnessed'.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材用加拿大 BLS-TOR/ALS-TOR 规则：ACLS 进行 15-20 分钟、三轮药物后与医生讨论；口诀「没电过、没 ROSC、没目击」。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC exam: continue until handover or signs of life; may stop at 30 minutes with no ROSC and no shocks, or 40 minutes if there was ever ROSC or a shock. Consult medical oversight to discontinue on scene.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲：持续到移交或出现生命迹象；满 30 分钟无 ROSC 且无除颤可停，曾有 ROSC 或除颤过则满 40 分钟。现场终止需联系 medical oversight。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Keep interruptions to 10 seconds or less.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：中断控制在 10 秒以内。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC states interruptions must be kept under 5 seconds — the stricter number is the exam answer.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 明确写中断要保持在 5 秒以内——考试答案取更严的这个数。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Two rescuers may run continuous compressions with 8-10 ventilations/min even before an advanced airway.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：双人时即使没有高级气道也可连续按压＋每分钟 8-10 次通气。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC: adults are 30:2 whether one or two rescuers; children/infants switch to 15:2 with two rescuers; neonates 3:1.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC：成人不论单人双人一律 30:2；儿童/婴儿双人时改 15:2；新生儿 3:1。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Textbook defers to hypothermia management; standard shockable-rhythm cycling otherwise.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把细节留给低体温章节，其余按常规可电击节律循环。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC: defibrillate up to three times if indicated, then continue CPR and transport rapidly WITHOUT pausing again for analysis or shocks. Allow 30-45 seconds to confirm pulselessness first.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC：按指征最多除颤 3 次，之后继续 CPR 快速转运，不再为分析或电击暂停。判定无脉可先花 30-45 秒确认。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The chapter teaches manual defibrillation, synchronized cardioversion, TCP, atropine, amiodarone, adenosine, and full 12-lead diagnosis as paramedic skills.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把手动除颤、同步电复律、经皮起搏、阿托品、胺碘酮、腺苷和完整 12 导诊断都当 paramedic 技能来教。
bcAlerts.bcEn: For the BC PCP (COPR-CPCF) exam these are ACP-level: PCP scope is the AED cycle, CPR quality, SGA insertion, and rhythm/STEMI material at recognition level only. Know what the interventions ARE and when they are indicated, not how to run them.
bcAlerts.bcZh: 在 BC PCP（COPR-CPCF）考试里这些属于 ACP 层级：PCP 授权范围是 AED 循环、按压质量、SGA 置入，心律与 STEMI 内容只考识别层级。要会认「这是什么、什么时候该用」，不考具体操作。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Chapter 30 is adult-focused; pediatric detail lives elsewhere in the text.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 第 30 章以成人为主，儿科细节在教材其他章节。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC exam pulls these in: start CPR if HR under 60 with poor perfusion; brachial pulse for infants; if alone, 5 cycles (2 min) of CPR before the AED; child pads for ages 0-8, else adult pads with adult energy; pads within 2.5 cm of each other go anterior/posterior; neonates 3:1 and NO AED; asphyxial arrest gets 5 cycles of CPR before AED analysis.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 考纲会考：心率低于 60 且灌注差即开始 CPR；婴儿摸肱动脉；单人先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR 再上 AED；0-8 岁用儿童电极片、没有就用成人片＋成人能量；两片间距不足 2.5 cm 改前后位；新生儿 3:1 且不用 AED；窒息性骤停先做 5 个循环 CPR 再分析。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The text presents nitroglycerin as a prehospital adjunct for pulmonary edema from left-sided heart failure — venodilation as an 'internal phlebotomy' offloading the pulmonary circulation.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把硝酸甘油列为左心衰肺水肿的院前辅助用药——靠扩静脉『体内放血』给肺循环减负。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's CHF/Pulmonary Edema protocol contains no nitroglycerin at any license level. The sequence is: sit upright with legs dependent, oxygen to SpO2 >= 94%, assist ventilation if LOC drops or SpO2 stays under 94%; PCP adds CPAP (start 5 cmH2O, max 10) or a PEEP valve on the BVM. In BC, nitro's only indication is cardiac-appearing chest discomfort.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 CHF/肺水肿协议里任何级别都没有硝酸甘油。流程是：坐位垂腿、给氧维持 SpO2 ≥94%、意识下降或 SpO2 <94% 就辅助通气；PCP 加用 CPAP（5 cmH2O 起、最大 10）或 BVM 加 PEEP 阀。在 BC，硝酸甘油唯一的适应证是疑似心源性胸部不适。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The case wrap-up teaches 160-325 mg of non-enteric-coated aspirin chewed, callable even by dispatchers before crew arrival.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材案例总结教的是 160–325 mg 非肠溶阿司匹林嚼服，调度员在到达前即可指导服用。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC fixes the dose at 160 mg PO and makes ASA the only medication requiring no vital signs first (give after the RBS). Contraindications: inability to swallow or allergy, active peptic ulcer or GI bleed, the day's recommended dose already taken, salicylate/NSAID-induced asthma history, and pediatric patients with viral symptoms.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 把剂量定死在 160 mg 口服，并且 ASA 是唯一给药前不需要先测生命体征的药（在 RBS 之后给）。禁忌：不能吞咽或过敏、活动性消化性溃疡或消化道出血、当日推荐剂量已服过、水杨酸/NSAID 诱发哮喘史、有病毒症状的儿科患者。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.47（Cardiac Chest Pain）、p.60（Aspirin 药典）

bcAlerts.topicEn: Pain persisting after nitro: the Entonox bridge
bcAlerts.topicZh: 硝酸甘油后疼痛不退：Entonox 桥接
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook chest pain pathway has no nitrous oxide step; analgesia beyond nitrates moves to other agents.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材的胸痛路径没有氧化亚氮这一步，硝酸酯之后的镇痛走别的药。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC-specific: if pain outlasts 3 nitro doses or SBP falls below 110, give Entonox starting 5 minutes after the last nitro dose (Entonox is contraindicated within 5 minutes of nitro). Thirty minutes after the first nitro dose the whole protocol may restart after stopping nitrous for 5 minutes; complete relief for over 5 minutes followed by returning pain counts as a new episode — restart nitro but never repeat the ASA.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 特有：疼痛扛过 3 剂硝酸甘油仍在，或 SBP 跌破 110，改给 Entonox——但必须距最后一剂硝酸甘油 5 分钟以上（5 分钟内是 Entonox 禁忌）。距首剂硝酸甘油 30 分钟后，停氧化亚氮 5 分钟可重启整套协议；疼痛完全缓解超 5 分钟后再复发算新发作——硝酸甘油可以重来，ASA 绝不重复。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.47（Chest Pain 流程）、p.65（Entonox 药典）、p.73-74

bcAlerts.topicEn: How long to resuscitate: ECLS horizons vs BC termination clock
bcAlerts.topicZh: 复苏做多久：ECLS 视野 vs BC 终止时钟
bcAlerts.bookEn: The ECLS discussion floats 10-30 minute handoff windows with 60 minutes as the benefit ceiling, and notes device-era survivors are reshaping beliefs about resuscitation duration and destination.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材 ECLS 部分讨论 10–30 分钟的交接窗、60 分钟的获益天花板，并提到装置时代的幸存者正在改写复苏时长与转运目的地的老观念。
bcAlerts.bcEn: For the BC EMR/PCP exam the clock is fixed: continue CPR/AED until care transfers, signs of life appear, 30 minutes pass with no ROSC and no defibrillation — or 40 minutes if ROSC or any shock occurred. ECLS, IABP, and Impella are specialty-transport material; the exam expects you to recognize devices, protect their lines, and run LVAD assessment, not to operate them.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC EMR/PCP 考试的时钟是死的：持续 CPR/AED 直到移交、出现生命征象、或 30 分钟无 ROSC 且从未除颤——若曾有 ROSC 或除过颤则到 40 分钟。ECLS、IABP、Impella 属于专科转运范畴；考试要求的是认得装置、保护管线、会做 LVAD 评估，而不是操作它们。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.39-40（CPR/AED 终止标准）
